author: clarkzhai0929
description: It is a post-apocalyptic adventure game where players control a loyal dog on a quest to find its lost owner. Navigating through devastated environments, players must combat mutated creatures, scavenge resources, and upgrade their abilities. The game combines emotional storytelling with survival mechanics, emphasizing strategic resource management and tactical combat in a world on the brink of collapse.
